events.title: Ghostscript sandbox-escape vulnerability enables RCE via crafted file uploads
events.one_liner: A patched use-after-free vulnerability (CVE-2026-125396) in Ghostscript allows crafted image and document files to escape sandbox protections and execute arbitrary commands on processing servers. The flaw affects common libraries used by WordPress, email clients, and print systems, with exploitation demonstrated across ten applications before the September 2026 fix.
takeaways: Use-after-free in font-loading code disables -dSAFER sandbox checks
Affects Ghostscript versions before 10.08.0 (patched Sept 8, 2026)
Exploitable via disguised files (.png, .jpg, .pdf extensions)
Demonstrated exploitation in WordPress Core, Roundcube, print queues, and plugins
CVE score 8.5/10; no active exploitation reported at publication

takeaways: Three providers publicly disclosed incidents: Novita, Phala, Together
OpenRouter off-boarded three providers entirely from platform
125 endpoints removed from Zero Data Retention eligibility
Incidents involved prompt leakage and data policy violations
OpenRouter's own systems were not breached
